Questions before we begin.

What information helps with an enquiry?

Share available drawings, the proposed scope, project area, site constraints and approximate timeframe. Detailed requirements can then be discussed directly.

Can you confirm the system performance?

Any fire, acoustic, structural or other performance requirement needs a project-specific design and specified system. This website does not provide performance guarantees.

Is price work or day work available?

Proniks advertises both. Availability, pricing and terms need to be agreed for your project.
